rationale: The note is an independent root heading drх, with its own etymology, followed by a second stem I with forms drəxle/dorəx and an example containing ko-dərxi. Those forms and the vine-layering sense belong to drx, not the preceding drn smoothing verb drəlle/dorən. The heading uses Cyrillic х in place of Latin x. Preserve the material by extracting a separate entry rather than leaving two unrelated stems I under drn.
